title: Bitstamp makes Ethereum staking fully live under Bitstamp Earn
description: Bitstamp announced that Ethereum staking was live for eligible customers under Bitstamp Earn after a gradual early-access rollout begun in April 2021.
notes: The 13 July 2021 first-party announcement is treated as the reviewed full public launch. Bitstamp's 22 April 2021 first-party article documents an earlier gradual rollout and early-access phase rather than a separate canonical platform identity.
